entries.204f8e725fcd0527: A company that manufactures commercial pumps and valves from its in-house developed special stainless alloy cast steel, and sells them to power plants, factories, water supply and sewage systems, and others.
entries.246720c7b585f72f: Pump products include self-priming volute pumps with an air-water separation mechanism (international patent), single-suction volute pumps combining corrosion and wear resistance from special stainless alloy cast steel, large mixed-flow pumps for flue gas desulfurization equipment at coal-fired power plants, and defoaming and degassing equipment that removes air from liquids.
entries.28208196991b3505: This consists of supplying maintenance parts to delivery destinations such as power plants and various factories, and periodic inspection and repair services using external maintenance contractors. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥758 million.
entries.2a4807e7af63d1df: The company was established in 1953 and traces its origins to Yokota Ponpu Kenkyūjo, founded in 1948 in Kure, Hiroshima Prefecture. Its head office is in Naka Ward, Hiroshima City, and it is listed on the Standard Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange. The number of employees as of March 31, 2026 was 80.
entries.2dcbc076812b3840: Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥2,308 million, of which pump products accounted for ¥1,168 million, parts and services for ¥758 million, and valve products for ¥381 million.
entries.4d237e9d7116acfb: Valve products include water-hammer-free check valves, which do not cause water hammer, and automatic control valves (constant flow valves and constant pressure valves) that automatically maintain a specified flow rate and pressure. They are used in water and sewage facilities, agricultural irrigation facilities and other settings. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥381 million.
entries.4f3d1b8c1123a1b3: As a “water solutions company” that solves fluid-related problems, mainly water, with its own technology, it is a business that takes orders for, develops, manufactures (casting, machining and assembly) and sells commercial pumps and valves. Products made from its in-house developed special stainless alloy cast steel are used in a wide range of settings, including power plants, various factories, agricultural irrigation facilities, water and sewage facilities, and aquariums. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥2,308 million.
entries.4fc239a1a29d88d2: By product, revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was led by pump products at ¥1,168 million, about half of the total and the core of the business, followed by parts and services at ¥758 million and valve products at ¥381 million.
entries.539b248178da685d: Maintenance parts and periodic inspection and construction services
entries.5c55e361fbbd2478: The “Business Overview” section states that the self-priming volute pump has an air-water separation mechanism (international patent), that the water hammer-free check valve is a valve that does not generate water hammer, and that products combining corrosion and wear resistance from special stainless alloy cast steel are used in a wide range of fields, including power plants, various factories, agricultural irrigation facilities, water and sewerage facilities and aquariums.
entries.5e712c470d2a38ea: Its products are used in a wide range of facilities that handle water, including power plants and various factories in iron and steel, non-ferrous metals, semiconductors, electronic equipment, food and chemicals, as well as agricultural irrigation facilities, water and sewerage facilities and aquariums.
entries.6b4705c5017a9594: It states that its management policy is to be a “technology-based company,” and that it maintains high earning power by focusing on niche markets to differentiate itself from peer companies. Its medium-term management strategy says it will strengthen technological and organizational capabilities to further enhance its relative advantage in existing niche markets while developing new niche markets. It positions providing solutions, not just products, for various water-related problems as the essence of its business.
